notes: REF-BM-02: metadata.ts/ingest.ts collect title, description, favicon but never a preview/og:image (no field for it anywhere in schema or types). REF-BM-03: AddBookmark.tsx only exposes a title field before saving (no description input); both are editable after saving in BookmarkDetail.tsx. REF-BM-14: no '#tag' inline search syntax — tags are only filtered via a separate structured UI control/param (search.ts parseQuery has no '#' handling; Search.tsx placeholder only mentions quotes). REF-BM-15: search.ts buildMatchExpr only supports quoted-phrase + implicit-AND prefix terms; no OR/NOT/parentheses support and no special-casing to let literal 'AND'/'OR' be quoted. REF-BM-23: NoteEditor.tsx is a contentEditable rich-text (HTML) editor sanitized via DOMPurify, not markdown source rendered to HTML. REF-BM-24: capture.ts/ingest.ts only store a Readability-extracted 'reader' article (sanitized excerpt), not a full single-file HTML snapshot of the original page; the PDF-instead-of-HTML rule itself is correctly implemented. REF-BM-25: no Internet Archive/wayback integration anywhere in the codebase. REF-BM-29: SavedSearch/saved_searches only stores keywords + an included tagFilter (max 2 tags, AND/OR) — there is no excluded-tags field or concept at all. REF-BM-32: only default sort order is persisted/adjustable (settings.ts is a generic KV store but no UI exists for 'displayed items' page size or font size).
